title: Synthesis and structural analysis of a ZIF-9/GO composite for green catalytic C–C bond formation and N-formylation: a spectroscopic study
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19500-19514
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02165K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Lalita Kumari, Rupali Mittal, Mehak Khurana, Satish Kumar Awasthi
This work reports synthesis of ZIF-9/GO composite to evaluate its catalytic efficiency in Knoevenagel reaction and formylation of amine, proves highly potent catalyst in terms of reaction time, yield, catalyst loading with improved green metrics.
